# Issue Certificate

## Summary
Re-evaluates completion, takes the next number from the authority, snapshots the facts onto a Certificate, links it, completes the enrolment.

## Refuses when
completion unmet (unless forced); already certified; withdrawn.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.
